_about: Where the data lands. 'defaults' applies to all feeds; each entry under 'feeds' overrides only what differs. Every feed key here must also exist in source_config.json - the notebook checks both sides and names any feed present in one file but not the other.

defaults._table_note: 'table' is the bare table name and is required per feed. Set append_filename_suffix true for one table per file, named <table>_<filename slug>.
defaults._schema_note: 'table_schema' null means derive it from the feed's source columns plus the selected metadata_columns, so there is no second copy of the schema to drift out of step.
defaults._metadata_note: metadata_columns selects by name from runtime_config.json's catalogue, which declares each column's type and the value it carries.

file_daily.description: Every date-stamped drop accumulates in dataplatform_dev.bronze_dev.Table02.
file_daily._write_note: Append, so re-running on the same day adds a second batch rather than replacing it. _batch_id distinguishes them; switch write_mode to overwrite if a re-run should replace instead.
